# volcanoplot
link.df<-data.frame(links)
goi.up <- c("ZIC1",
         "MYT1L",
         "AQP4",
         "LHX8",
         "GPR17",
         "GDF7")
goi.down <- c(
         "BCAS1",
         "CNTN2",
         "MOBP")

peak.df <- link.df[0,]
colnames(peak.df) <- colnames(link.df)
for (gene in goi.up) {
  link.df.ord<-link.df[order(link.df$score,decreasing = T), ]
  peak.df<-rbind(peak.df,link.df.ord[link.df.ord$gene == gene,][1,])
}

for (gene in goi.down) {
  link.df.ord<-link.df[order(link.df$score,decreasing = F), ]
  peak.df<-rbind(peak.df,link.df.ord[link.df.ord$gene == gene,][1,])
}


ggplot(link.df, aes(x=score, y=-1*log10(pvalue))) + 
  geom_point(size = 0.5) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0.05, linetype=2, color="red") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = -0.05, linetype=2, color= "red") + 
  theme_bw() +
  geom_label_repel(
    data = peak.df, 
    aes(label = gene),                     
    box.padding = 0.6,                            
    point.padding = 0.3,                          
    segment.color = "black",                         
    segment.size = 0.5                            
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

```{Figure 6b}
# get "top" linked peaks and their associated genes
peaks_ordered <-table(links$peak)[order(table(links$peak),decreasing = T)] %>% names()
top_linked_peaks <- peaks_ordered[1:50]
top_linked_peak_genes <-links$gene[links$peak %in% top_linked_peaks] %>% unique()

gene_tbl <-table(links$gene)[order(table(links$gene),decreasing = T)]
gene_tbl_df <-table(links$gene)[order(table(links$gene),decreasing = F)] %>% data.frame()
gene_tbl_df$rank<- rownames(gene_tbl_df) %>% as.numeric()


uq_gene_tbl_df <- gene_tbl_df %>%
  distinct(Freq, .keep_all = TRUE)

df <- gene_tbl_df
# Collapse identical link counts
curve <- df |>
  group_by(Freq) |>
  summarise(rank=max(rank),.groups="drop") |>
  arrange(Freq) |>
  mutate(
    x=(rank-min(df$rank))/diff(range(df$rank)),
    y=(Freq-min(Freq))/diff(range(Freq)),
    distance=x-y)


# Maximum-distance elbow
cutoff_links <- curve$Freq[which.max(curve$distance)]
cutoff_rank <- min(df$rank[df$Freq > cutoff_links])

goi <- c("PAX6","HES1", "SOX9","AQP4","CD44","SLC1A2","RGMA","NFIA","FOXC1","ETS1")
library(ggrepel)

ggplot(df,aes(rank,Freq)) +
  geom_point(size = 1.5)+
  geom_line() +
  geom_vline(xintercept=cutoff_rank,linetype="dashed",color="red") +
  labs(x="Gene rank",y="Number of linked ATAC peaks") +
  theme_bw() +
geom_label_repel(
  data = subset(df, df$Var1 %in% goi), # <-- Filter for points to label
  aes(label = Var1),                     # <-- Must match geom_jitter
  box.padding = 0.6,                             # Spaces out the labels
  point.padding = 0.3,                           # Space between label line and point
  segment.color = "black",                         # Color of the connecting lines
  segment.size = 0.5                             # Thickness of the connecting lines
) +
  theme_minimal()

# Prepare the GWAS regions
library(dplyr)
library(LOLA)

# Choose a 500 bp window on each side of each SNP
window_size <- 500

# Output database location
db_path <- "gwas_regionDB/hg38"
collection_path <- file.path(db_path, "GWAS_traits")
regions_path <- file.path(collection_path, "regions")

dir.create(regions_path, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# Prepare SNP coordinates
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)

window_size <- 500

gwas_df <- gwas_trunc %>%
  mutate(
    chrom = as.character(chrom),
    disease_trait = as.character(`category`)
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(chrom),
    !is.na(disease_trait),
    disease_trait != ""
  ) %>%
  extract(
    chrom,
    into = c("chr", "pos_start", "pos_end"),
    regex = "^(chr[^-]+)-(\\d+)-(\\d+)$",
    remove = FALSE
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    pos_start = as.integer(pos_start),
    pos_end = as.integer(pos_end),
    start = pmax(1L, pos_start - window_size),
    end = pos_end + window_size
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(pos_start), !is.na(pos_end)) %>%
  distinct(chr, start, end, disease_trait)

traits <- sort(unique(gwas_df$disease_trait))

trait_files <- data.frame(
  disease_trait = traits,
  filename = sprintf("trait_%04d.bed", seq_along(traits))
)

# Write BED files: chromosome, 0-based start, end
for (i in seq_len(nrow(trait_files))) {
  
  trait <- trait_files$disease_trait[i]
  
  bed_df <- gwas_df %>%
    filter(disease_trait == trait) %>%
    distinct(chr, start, end) %>%
    transmute(
      chr = chr,
      start = start - 1L,
      end = end
    )
  
  write.table(
    bed_df,
    file = file.path(regions_path, trait_files$filename[i]),
    sep = "\t",
    quote = FALSE,
    row.names = FALSE,
    col.names = FALSE
  )
}

# LOLA region-set metadata
index_df <- data.frame(
  filename = trait_files$filename,
  description = trait_files$disease_trait,
  cellType = "NA",
  tissue = "NA",
  dataSource = "GWAS Catalog",
  date = as.character(Sys.Date())
)

write.table(
  index_df,
  file = file.path(collection_path, "index.txt"),
  sep = "\t",
  quote = FALSE,
  row.names = FALSE
)

# LOLA collection metadata

)

write.table(

  sep = "\t",

  row.names = FALSE
)

# Inspect enriched GWAS traits
results <- results %>%
  arrange(qValue)

head(results)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(circlize)
library(grid)

# Map each LOLA result to its GWAS trait description
res_heat <- as.data.frame(results) %>%
  left_join(
    as.data.frame(regionDB$regionAnno) %>%
      dplyr::select(dbSet, description),
    by = "dbSet",
    suffix = c(".result", ".annotation")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    disease_trait = coalesce(description.annotation, description.result),
    logQ = -log10(pmax(qValue, 1e-300))
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(userSet), !is.na(disease_trait))

# If a cell-type/trait pair occurs multiple times, keep the strongest
heatmap_df <- res_heat %>%
  group_by(userSet, disease_trait) %>%
  summarise(
    logQ = max(logQ, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Convert to a cell type x trait matrix
mat <- heatmap_df %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = disease_trait,
    values_from = logQ
  ) %>%
  as.data.frame()

rownames(mat) <- as.character(mat$userSet)
mat$userSet <- NULL

mat <- as.matrix(mat)
storage.mode(mat) <- "numeric"

# Select the 30 traits with the strongest enrichment across cell types
top_n <- min(30, ncol(mat))

top_traits <- names(
  sort(apply(mat, 2, max, na.rm = TRUE), decreasing = TRUE)
)[seq_len(top_n)]

mat <- mat[, top_traits, drop = FALSE]

Heatmap(
  mat,
  name = "-log10(q)",
  col = colorRamp2(
    c(0,  2),
    c("white","#08306B")
  ),
  na_col = "grey90",
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_columns = TRUE,
  show_row_names = TRUE,
  show_column_names = TRUE,
  show_column_dend = F,
  show_row_dend = F,
  column_names_rot = 45,
  row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 9),
  column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 8),
  column_title = "GWAS trait",
  row_title = "Cell type", rect_gp = grid::gpar(col = "black", lwd = 0.5)
)
df<-as.data.frame(mat)
df$Cell_Type <- rownames(df)
writexl::write_xlsx(df,"output/tables/GWAS_trait_df.xlsx")
```
